captureType: Sequential screenshots of actual UI actions, not a real-time video recording
title: Calibration Explorer 0.2.0 reference workflow
context: Captured on 4 October 2026 from the public version 0.2.0 using the UCI handwritten-digit reference. These are Codex-operated engineering observations, with zero independent human participants. The 80% threshold is illustrative, not optimised or recommended.

steps.title: Load the reference
steps.caption: Load the handwritten-digit reference. Policy validation is selected; the 1,797 test rows remain unopened.
steps.alt: Calibration Explorer with the UCI handwritten-digit reference loaded, Policy validation selected and the test split unopened.

steps.title: Inspect a linked reliability bin
steps.caption: Select original bin 15: 412 predictions, 98.3% mean confidence and 100% observed accuracy.
steps.alt: Original reliability chart with bin 15 selected and linked details showing 412 predictions, 98.3% confidence and 100% accuracy.

steps.title: Fit on calibration rows
steps.caption: Fit temperature using only 574 calibration rows. The fitted value is 0.72598.
steps.alt: Calibrate stage showing a fitted temperature of 0.72598 from 574 calibration observations, with Policy validation still selected.

steps.title: Lock an illustrative threshold
steps.caption: Lock an illustrative 80% threshold on policy validation before opening the test split.
steps.alt: Decide stage with an 80% threshold locked at temperature 0.7260 on policy validation; the next action is Review test results.

steps.title: Review the test comparison
steps.caption: Review 1,797 test predictions. Accuracy stays at 94.9%; NLL changes from 0.1760 to 0.1575.
steps.alt: Test comparison showing 1,797 observations, unchanged 94.9% accuracy, ECE changing from 0.0365 to 0.0101 and NLL from 0.1760 to 0.1575.

steps.title: Preview and save the report
steps.caption: Preview the test report. Source rows are excluded; the actual HTML download matches this preview.
steps.alt: Export stage with HTML, JSON and CSV controls, source rows unchecked, and a preview labelled as the same snapshot used by the HTML download.

sequence.processing: Screenshots held sequentially without cropping, scaling, added UI, pointer movement or transitions. At most one white pixel is added on the right or bottom for even video dimensions.
